snippet.title: There Goes the Kingdom – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
There Goes the Kingdom is a free survivors-like roguelite for Android: run, jump and slide through a horde that never stops growing, and build a hero one booster-pack card at a time. 16 unqualified heroes, bosses, and online co-op for up to 4 players.

🎮 Free on Google Play: https://theregoesthekingdom.com/links?from=youtube
💬 Discord: https://theregoesthekingdom.com/discord
🌐 https://theregoesthekingdom.com

Made by one person at Knot Head Games. Coming to Steam.
